subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare provider gain a backward-compatible Workers AI endpoint/model mode, or should Workers AI remain an explicitly documented generic custom-provider setup?
rationale: Both paths can satisfy the immediate user need, but they establish different long-term provider identities, onboarding contracts, model catalogs, and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Add Workers AI mode
options.body: Extend the Cloudflare provider plugin to generate Workers AI endpoint, protocol, model metadata, and default selection while preserving the existing Anthropic mode.

options.title: Standardize custom-provider setup
options.body: Keep the bundled Cloudflare provider Anthropic-focused and document an exact supported non-interactive custom-provider command for Workers AI.

recommendation.title: Add Workers AI mode
recommendation.body: Extend the Cloudflare provider plugin to generate Workers AI endpoint, protocol, model metadata, and default selection while preserving the existing Anthropic mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Cloudflare provider contribution is the strongest available feature-history signal for deciding its intended product scope.
